scene: The gentleman tips his bowler and unlocks three strange transit departure gates.
picture: A flat side view along the ceiling concourse. The girl stands left of centre holding her sketchbook. To her left, an open arch reveals a swaying wicker rooftop gondola. Beside her, the mustachioed gentleman points toward an idling brass carousel train at centre. At far right sits a docked glass pneumatic tube pod.
shown: a wicker gondola suspended outside an open window on the left
a brass clockwork carousel train idling at a centre platform gate
a sleek glass pneumatic tube pod docked at the far right
